argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$b='http://127.0.0.1:17448'
$as=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($b+'/api/supervisor-watchdog/agent-assignments') -TimeoutSec 15
$r=@($as.assignments|Where-Object {$_.id -eq '9f434c35-9e28-4807-8d5f-18569e8bdcf5'})
if($r.Count -ne 1){throw 'ASSIGNMENT_ID_MISSING'}
$t=$r[0]
foreach($k in @('state','dispatchCount','dispatchSubmitAttempted','lastPreflightReason','lastDiagnostic','currentHead','ciRunId','ciConclusion','evidenceCollectorStatus','completedAt','blockedAt','failedAt','evidenceDeadlineAt')){Write-Output ($k+'='+[string]$t.$k)}
Write-Output ('OTHER_ACTIVE='+@($as.assignments|Where-Object {$_.id -ne $t.id -and $_.state -in @('queued','dispatching','running','awaiting_evidence','unknown')}).Count)
Write-Output ('BRIDGE_HEAD='+(& git.exe -C 'E:\WebAIBridge' rev-parse HEAD))
Write-Output ('R67_NODE_LOG_EXISTS='+(Test-Path 'E:\boss-R67-QA-PORTABLE-VERIFY-20261014-GPT6\R67_NODE_TEST.txt'))
Write-Output ('R67_PYTHON_LOG_EXISTS='+(Test-Path 'E:\boss-R67-QA-PORTABLE-VERIFY-20261014-GPT6\R67_PYTHON_TEST.txt'))
